title: Video desk, Wed Nov 11 set: Sector Scoreboard (10 largest sectors), Myth vs Fact (Veterans Day market hours), Inside the AI Studio (Nov 9-11)

general-counsel-agent.note: All ten checks on file after reviewing the three 9:16 review sheets, report.json spoken text, titles, captions and sources. Defamation screen: sector data from Webull, market-hours facts reported by two outlets, and the studio's own records; no reason is given for any sector move and no person is named. Nothing commits the owner; delivery is to the owner only. AI review, not legal advice.

advertising-consumer-protection-counsel.note: Every number traces to a saved raw response or a named source: sector changes and up/down counts to raw/sectors_D1.json and raw/sectors_D5.json; SPY's 32.0M shares to the sum of the 78 bars in raw/spy_m5.json; market hours, the SIFMA bond close, bank closures and Thanksgiving Nov 26 to Fox Television Stations' Veterans Day 2026 guide and StockTitan. Studio counts trace to book-kit/records, pod-kit/decisions, video-kit/records (Nov 9-11) and chart-lab out/results.json. The studio video makes no sales, income or product-availability claim; it says the owner reviews everything before release. Outros say 'Follow for more' with no schedule promise.

email-anti-spam-compliance-counsel.note: No commercial email. The delivery email goes to the owner only.

privacy-data-protection-counsel.note: No personal data. No private person is named; the owner isn't named or shown.

copyright-fair-use-counsel.note: Visuals are drawn from data by the kit's renderer; the voice is Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0); music is synthesized per video by music.py; fonts are Inter, Space Grotesk and JetBrains Mono (SIL OFL). The market-hours facts are stated in our own words with outlets credited; no quotes, logos, footage, screenshots or third-party images. Studio product names are the studio's own.

trademark-brand-clearance-counsel.note: NYSE, Nasdaq, SIFMA, the Federal Reserve, SPY, Webull, Fox Television Stations and StockTitan are named only to refer to them (nominative use); no logos, nothing suggests endorsement. Sector labels are generic. Studio design names (Grandpa's Fishing Hole, Gemini Constellation, Kitchen Herbs) already passed the POD trademark screen. Hashtags are generic. No USPTO search needed: no new brand or series name.

financial-content-compliance-counsel.note: 'Educational only. Not financial advice.' is on screen in the sector and Veterans Day videos and in both captions; the studio video and caption say 'Research only. Not financial advice.' next to the chart-lab line. No buy or sell calls, no targets, no 'what happens next'. No reason is given for the chip or oil moves; the video says reasons are only given when two outlets report them. The 'passed its tests' line describes the lab's own backtest status, not a recommendation.

platform-terms-policy-counsel.note: Synthetic TTS narration over data charts and text cards; no realistic depiction of real people or events. Meta asks for a label on AI-generated audio, so turn on 'AI info' on Instagram and Facebook. The studio video says the work is made by AI agents. Titles match the content.

kids-content-coppa-counsel.note: General-audience content, not directed to children. The studio video mentions kids' coloring books as products but shows no child and uses no child's data. Mark 'not made for kids' where a platform asks.

contracts-commercial-terms-counsel.note: No paid tools, licensed assets or third-party agreements. Webull data is read-only and used for commentary. The studio video promises no delivery dates, prices or availability for any product.
